## Summary / 变更摘要

## Verification / 验证

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Relevant isolated integration tests / 相关隔离集成测试

## Documentation impact / 文档影响（必填）

Describe whether installation, startup, configuration, commands, or release behavior changed. Link updated docs, or explain concretely why no documentation change is needed.

说明是否影响安装、启动、配置、命令或发布行为；链接相应文档修改，或明确解释为什么无需修改文档。

- [ ] Shared installation content updated at its source; `npm run docs:sync` applied where needed.
- [ ] `npm run docs:check` passes; no manual edits to generated blocks.
- [ ] No local npm publication or Release asset uploads. Release operations remain in GitHub Actions.
